kjv: keep through thine own name those whom thou hast given me
mine: keep them in your name, which you have given me
note: TR "hous" (those whom) against "ho" (dative "which", attracted to "name") in P66, P75, Sinaiticus, B; the early text speaks of the divine name given to Jesus. Also 17:12.

kjv: thou shouldest keep them from the evil
mine: that you keep them from the evil one
note: tou ponerou is most likely masculine, as in 1 Jn 2:13–14, 5:18–19.
